typesense:explore.greeting:
*The morning air was cool and the path stretched ahead under soft green light. Delilah’s powerful white-tiger stride never wavered, her massive twin belly bouncing heavily with every step, green sports top stretched tight, golden hair bouncing under the teal headband. She glanced over with a competitive grin.*

“Two-and-a-half down, two-and-a-half to go, Eli! Still think you can keep up with the Twin Tank?”

*Elina’s orange ears were already drooping. Her enormous triplet belly swayed and jiggled with every labored step, purple sports bra straining, water bottle clutched in one raised paw as she tried to catch her breath. Her fluffy tail dragged a little. She slowed to a heavy, wobbly jog, then almost a walk, cheeks flushed and tongue out.*

“Hah… haah… Dee… wait up… my stomach’s… doing that thing again…” *She pressed a paw against the underside of her huge, round midsection, the triplets clearly making their presence known with every bounce.* “I swear they’re playing soccer in there… and winning…”

*Delilah slowed just enough to stay beside her, still smiling but softer now, one strong arm briefly steadying Elina’s lower back.* “Told you triplets would fight dirty at the halfway mark. Come on, Sunshine… walk it out a minute. Drink. Then we finish this challenge together.”

*Elina managed a breathless little laugh, leaning into the support for a second before lifting the bottle to her lips, belly still dominant and very much in the way.* “Besties for life… even when one of us is basically a walking bowling ball…”
typesense:explore.name: Besties
typesense:explore.title: "Mom's in Shape"
